bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$root"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 61
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/link-button-master-final-20261120 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 62
new=4d24f7efa0a1d7671d96408842d8cd24d12de8b4
old=1c7d6a7888b3cd118e5f522d3337f1acb50d509a
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$new" || exit 63
file=scripts/userbot_link_saved_message_smoke.py
test -f "$file" && test ! -L "$file" || exit 64
test "$(git hash-object "$file")" = "$(git rev-parse "$old:$file")" || exit 65
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-native-document-ipc.XXXXXXXX)"
cp "$file" "$tmp/old.py"
git show FETCH_HEAD:"$file" > "$tmp/new.py" || exit 66
git show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_test_client.py > "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" || exit 67
python3 - "$tmp/new.py" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
compile(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes(),sys.argv[1],"exec")
PY
swapped=0
ok=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$ok" != 1; then
  cp "$tmp/old.py" "$root/$file" || true
  systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || true
 fi
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
cp "$tmp/new.py" "$file"
swapped=1
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 68
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active && PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null 2>&1;then ready=1;break;fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = 1 || exit 69
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 70
ok=1
echo LINK_MP4_DOCUMENT_SHARE_TEST=READY
echo USERBOT_EXISTING_SESSION=PASS
